name: token-meter
description: Token meter above the prompt: the session's tokens on a gauge with round goals, in the BUS pane's style

style.title: Style
style.description: Look of the BUS pane and the token meter: amber (phosphor tube), 1bit (ink on black, dithered) or firefly (lime on moss). The switcher in the BUS pane, "/bus style" and /config set both.
